node.title: PROVED (Pro Brief B partial): the spread/rank-defect dichotomy + descent
node.statement: Three lemmas (Pro, refereed + sanity-checked at r = 2): (L1) at every point of P cap D_j, either the incident hyperplane functionals are SPREAD (I_r(p) >= (1-alpha)^{r-1} C(m,r) independent r-subsets, greedy span-avoidance) or > alpha m of them lie in a proper subspace — the RANK-DEFECT case, yielding a positive-dimensional proper subflat carrying the shared divisor g_S; (L2) spread points number <= C(n,r) / [(1-alpha)^{r-1} C(j,r)] (double counting through independent r-tuples); (L3) coincidence gives STRICT descent — division by g_S is linear, degree drops by |S|, dimension drops, landing in F_{dim Q} or re-triggering gcd-reduction. r=3 specialization at alpha = 2/3 with the twin/pencil-through-a-line branch split. CRITICAL CORRECTION: 'coincidence' = rank defect, NOT equal hyperplanes — the pencil-through-a-line configuration (planes X0 = aX1, no twins, multiplicity n on the common line) refutes the twin-only reading in dim >= 3.
